scheme_name: Distribution Of Tractor Unit Under CMSGUY
other_conditions: A group of 8‑10 actual adult farmers from the same village must apply together
All members must have a common bank account and sign the application form
Only one member per family is allowed in the group
Benefits cannot be availed by individuals
benefits_summary: Provides a 70% subsidy (up to ₹5,50,000) on tractor units with a 20% bank loan and 10% beneficiary share, enabling the group to rent tractors to village farmers for at least five years.
